retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a central subject by a vintage car with bold, condensed typography anchored at the bottom.
triggerTerms: condensed white typography on dark background
excludeWhen: high-key lighting without shadows is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, monochromatic composition featuring a woman in a white t-shirt standing beside a classic car, characterized by heavy film grain, soft focus, and a stark white condensed title overlaying the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white t-shirt contrasting against dark foliage background
Metallic car reflections mirroring the monochromatic tonal range
Bold white typography anchored to the bottom center
Soft, diffused lighting creating a cinematic, nostalgic atmosphere
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a female subject, slightly off-center to the right, occupying the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale white text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the hands on the car door, ending at the bold title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus foliage in the upper left quadrant provides breathing room for the advisory badge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays and deep blacks in the background and car.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the subject's shirt and the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver and chrome highlights on the vehicle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white shirt/text and the dark background.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the subject's torso and the car

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for impact; secondary metadata uses a standard block sans-serif in a boxed layout.
graphicDevices: Rectangular advisory box in the top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides a similar heavy, condensed feel though slightly wider.
Classic condensed sans-serif that fits the aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white, grainy photograph of a woman in a white v-neck t-shirt standing next to a vintage 1980s luxury sedan. The background should be dark, out-of-focus trees and a brick wall. The lighting should be soft and cinematic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, extra-condensed white sans-serif title in all caps across the bottom third of the image. Add a small black and white rectangular advisory badge in the top left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the text centered and extra-condensed?
Does the subject wear a plain white shirt?

postGenerationChecks: Verify text is not cut off by edges
Ensure grain does not obscure facial features
Confirm the car looks period-accurate to the late 20th century
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Vintage Car + Condensed Sans-Serif Overlay
